title: Text Reverser
h1: Text Reverser — Reverse Characters in Any String
seoTitle: Free Text Reverser — Reverse Text Online Instantly
description: Reverse the character order of any text or string. Perfect for puzzles, testing, or curiosity. Runs privately in your browser with no uploads.
intro: Paste text and reverse every character in one click. The entire process stays on your device.
blurb: Flip the order of characters in any text instantly and privately.
howItWorks: Enter or paste the text you want to reverse.
Click the Reverse button to flip the character sequence.
Copy the reversed text from the output area.
examples: A sentence with spaces and punctuation is fully reversed character by character.

faq.q: Does it reverse word order or individual characters?
faq.a: It reverses the entire string character by character, so spaces and punctuation move with the characters.

faq.q: Is any data sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Reversal is performed entirely inside your browser using simple JavaScript.
